mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM_RESERVATION WHERE ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND TRUNC(RESV_CHECK_IN) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND RESV_STATUS != '예약취소'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM_RESERVATION WHERE ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} AND TRUNC(RESV_CHECK_OUT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND RESV_STATUS != '예약취소'

SELECT RESV_NUM AS resvNum, ADMIN_IDX AS adminIdx, USER_MAIL AS userMail, RESV_PRICE AS resvPrice, RESV_PEOPLE AS resvPeople, RESV_STATUS AS resvStatus, RESV_PAY_STATUS AS resvPayStatus, RESV_PAY_METHOD AS resvPayMethod, RESV_ARRIVAL_TIME AS resvArrivalTime, RESV_REQUEST AS resvRequest, RESV_DAY AS resvDay, RESV_ORDER_ID AS resvOrderId, RESV_LAST_NAME_EN AS resvLastNameEn, RESV_FIRST_NAME_EN AS resvFirstNameEn, RESV_LAST_NAME_JP AS resvLastNameJp, RESV_FIRST_NAME_JP AS resvFirstNameJp, RESV_MAIL AS resvMail, RESV_COUNTRY AS resvCountry, RESV_TEL AS resvTel FROM RESERVATION WHERE RESV_NUM = #{resvNum}

SELECT USER_MAIL AS userMail, USER_PASSWORD AS userPassword, USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, USER_ADDRESS AS userAddress, USER_COUNTRY AS userCountry, USER_TEL AS userTel FROM MEMBER WHERE USER_MAIL = #{userMail}

SELECT rm.ROOM_NAME AS roomName, p.PLAN_NAME AS planName, rr.RESV_CHECK_IN AS resvCheckIn, rr.RESV_CHECK_OUT AS resvCheckOut, rr.RESV_PEOPLE AS resvPeople, rr.RESV_PRICE AS resvPrice FROM ROOM_RESERVATION rr JOIN ROOM rm ON rm.ROOM_IDX = rr.ROOM_IDX LEFT JOIN PLAN p ON p.PLAN_IDX = rr.PLAN_IDX WHERE rr.RESV_NUM = #{resvNum} ORDER BY rr.ROOM_RESV_NUM

SELECT c.RESTAURANT_COURSE_NAME AS courseName, rr.RESTAURANT_USE_DATE AS restaurantUseDate, rr.RESTAURANT_TIME_SLOT AS restaurantTimeSlot, rr.RESTAURANT_HEADCOUNT AS restaurantHeadcount, rr.RESTAURANT_SIDEMENU AS restaurantSidemenu FROM RESTAURANT_RESERVATION rr LEFT JOIN RESTAURANT_COURSE c ON c.RESTAURANT_COURSE_IDX = rr.COURSE_IDX WHERE rr.RESV_NUM = #{resvNum} ORDER BY rr.RESTAURANT_FACILITY_IDX

SELECT o.ONSEN_NAME AS onsenName, orr.ONSEN_USE_DATE AS onsenUseDate, orr.ONSEN_TIME_SLOT AS onsenTimeSlot, orr.ONSEN_HEADCOUNT AS onsenHeadcount, orr.ONSEN_STATUS AS onsenStatus FROM ONSEN_RESERVATION orr LEFT JOIN ONSEN o ON o.ONSEN_IDX = orr.ONSEN_IDX WHERE orr.RESV_NUM = #{resvNum} ORDER BY orr.ONSEN_FACILITY_IDX
